answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 13358 Country: LK Title: is it permissible for a man to look at other than the face and hands of the woman that he wishes to propose? Question: is it permissible for a man to look at other than the face and hands of the woman that he wishes to propose? Answer ID: 13358 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1243/974=H/1430) No, rather it is unlawful and sin. He is allowed only to have a look at her face and figure etc with modesty. If he wants some additional information, he should enquire it through his relative women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
